subhead: Legal scholar Ülle Madise was elected on Wednesday to lead Estonia, with support from part of the parliamentary opposition. title: French financial prosecutor calls for trial in Polynesian branch of 'Qatargate'
subhead: According to information obtained by Le Monde, the national financial prosecutor's office has recommended that four individuals stand trial, including former Tahitian FIFA official Reynald Temarii and Qatari billionaire Mohamed bin Hammam, in connection with the controversial awarding of the 2022 football World Cup to Qatar.

title: Leaked Spanish report  claims 'total permissiveness' of Morocco over Ceuta crisis

title: War in Ukraine: Constant air raid alerts unsettle daily life in Kyiv
